title: 1.1 Conduct
html:
As a member of the Ghost Unit, you are expected to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and on duty, and off duty in uniform. This is includes but is not limited to: general respect towards all others, professionalism in all interactions, adherence to all department policies and server rules, etc.

Ghost Unit uniforms may be worn off-duty only when not in roleplay. We trust our troopers to respect this policy. Failure to do so may result in infractions.

You are representing not only yourself but the entire Ghost Unit's reputation. Any actions bringing disrepute to the deparmtent may result in disciplinary action, including removal if severe.

title: 1.4 Weapon Regulations
html:
Unless stated otherwise for specialised units, all personnel are required to carry the Glock 17 as their primary Sidearm. The M4A1, and Ruger SR556 may be carried as long guns. Non-lethal weapons such as the bean-bag shotgun, tazer, OC-spray, and baton can be carrised at the discretion of the trooper.

Use of Force

The use of force, whether lethal, less-lethal or non-lethal, must at all times be proportionate to the level of threat posed to personnel and those in the immediate vicinity. Personnel are prohibited from applying force that exceeds what is reasonably necessary to control or neutralise a given situation. Where circumstances permit, verbal de-escalation must be attempted as the first course of action. Should de-escalation prove ineffective, less-lethal and non-lethal options must be tired before any escalation to lethal force is considered.

Lethal force is only authorised as a last resort, specifically when there exists an imminent and credible threat to the life of personnel, a hostage, a victim, or a civilian, and no viable alternative remains. Indiscriminate or retaliatory use of force is strictly prohibited and will be treated as a serious infraction.

Personnel must observe the following priority of life order at all times when operating in high-risk situations:

  1. Officer / Operative / Trooper
  2. Hostage / Victim / Civilian
  3. Suspect(s)

Failure to comply with the use of force policy may result in immediate infraction, suspension, or removal from the department depending on the severity of the violation.

title: 1.5 Quota
html: As a member of the Ghost Unit, you are required to meet a minimum shift time of 2 hours per week by at latest Tuesday 18:00 UTC. Infractions waves may be delayed at the discretion of HICOM. Accumulating more than 4 hours within a single wave renders you elligible for promotions if rank-section-related conditions are met. If you are unable to meet your quota or rank-section responsibilities, file for a Leave of Absence before Monday 23:59 UTC.

title: 1.6 Traffic Stops & Arrests
html:
When conducting traffic stops and arrests, troopers must follow all departmental guidelines and procedures. This includes proper documentation, in the form of logs with the Ghost Unit Utilities bot, ensuring safety of all parties involved, and maintaining professionalism throughout the process. Personnel must always identify themselves clearly with atleast their name and rank. Personnel must inform suspects of their rights when applicable, as well as the reason for the stop / arrest when earliest safe and possible to do so.

Troopers must always ensure they have adequate backup when dealing with potentially dangerous suspects. This includes requesting additional units from within the Ghost Unit and sub-divisions as well as other departments.

Personnel must have probable cause before initiating any traffic stop or arrest.

Failure to comply with these regulations may lead to infractions, and possible removal from the department / sub-divisions if severe.

title: 1.7 Pursuits
html: Personnel are required to engange in soley in pursuits when deemed necessary to decrease the danger a suspect may pose. Pursuits must be terminated immediately if deemed unsafe to continue. The position and statuts of the pursuing units must be communicated clearly when safe to do so. Troopers must always prioritize the safety of themselves, other road users, and the suspect. Personnel may not overtake units ahead of them unless explicitly authorized to do so by the primary unit. Crashes must be roleplayed accordingly, and excessive force must be avoided. All FSRP rules must be followed at any time during pursuits.

title: 1.8 Shift Management
html:
All shifts must be logged through the Ghost Unit Utilities bot when using any GU assets. The according shift type must be selected when starting a shift. Shifts must me paused or set "on break" when not actively patrolling or engaging in department-related activities. Shifts may be managed via a command channel. The following commands may be used with the bot:

  • /shift_manage - Starts / stops / pauses shift
  • /shift_leaderboard - Shows current shift leaderboard
  • /shift_online - Lists all active shifts

title: 1.9 Leave of Absence
html:
Personnel may request a leave of absence via the Ghost Unit Utilities bot by using the /loa_request command when unable to fulfill quota or duties. Approval is subject to the the following:

  • The request may not be longer than 4 weeks
  • The request may not be submitted within 1 week of a previous.
  • Requests submitted after Monday 23:59 UTC will not give immunity to shift infractions if quota is not met.
  • Probationary ranks may not file for leave of absences.
  • Request must contain at minimum a vague concievalbe reason.

During the duration of the Leave of Absence, personnel are exempt from quota and duty requirements. However, personnel are not permitted to participate in any department-related activities including but not limited to shifts, events, and trainings, with the exception of game nights. Failure to comply with these regulations may lead to infractions, and possible removal from the department / sub-divisions if repeated.

title: 1.10 Promotions Requirement
html:
Promotion eligibility requirements vary by rank. The following are general duties and requirements. Only applicable conditions are considered.

General Requirements

  • Meet promotion quota
  • Be off cooldown (between 1 and 10 weeks)
  • Engange semi-frequently with the community
  • Have no infractions in the week leading up to a promotion wave

HICOM Requirements

  • Be active in-game
  • Issue infractions when warranted
  • Handle resignation requests
  • Lead or manage a sub-division
  • Engage with the community
  • Handle tickets
  • Contribute to the server
  • Host or assist in mass deployments and events

SHR and HR Requirements

  • Be active in-game
  • Engage with the community
  • Handle tickets
  • Receive positive feedback in trooper reviews
  • Avoid being infracted
  • Issue / request infractions when warranted
  • Assist in events / deployments when requested
  • Assist in field training programmes

SGT Programme Requirements

  • Be active in-game
  • Handle tickets
  • Avoid being infracted
  • Host trainings and ride alongs
  • Supervise on dutys units

LR Requirements

  • Be active in-game
  • Avoid being infracted
  • Display professionalism

title: 1.11 Infractions
html:
Infractions are issued to maintain professionalism, fairness, and compliance with department and server standards. The following actions may result in an infraction. This list is non-exhaustive.

  • Failure to use proper spelling, punctuation, and grammar (SPaG) in public communications or in-game
  • Failure to meet community or department standards
  • Failure to end shift when not actively fufilling departmental tasks
  • Failure to follow lawful instructions from a High Rank
  • Abuse or misuse of authority or power
  • Failure to follow department policies or server rules
  • Unprofessional conduct, on-duty or off-duty in uniform
  • Failure to meet quotas / requirements without an approved Leave of Absence
  • Failure to correctly log traffic stops or arrest
  • Use of unauthorised firearms, vehicles, liveries, or uniforms
  • Violation of any service's terms of service
  • Initiating a traffic stop without probable cause
  • Conducting traffic stops on Whitelisted departments for traffic violations
  • Causing or escalating drama within the department or with other departments
  • Disrespectful behavior toward other members or departments
  • Failure to identify when safe to do so
  • Leaking internal documents, information, or channels

Severity, intent, repetition, and prior history will be considered when issuing infractions. Severe or repeated violations may result in suspension or removal from the department.

title: 1.12 Resignations and Reinstatements
html:
Base Rules

You must hold the minimum rank of @FHP Ghost | Master Trooper to be eligible for @FHP Ghost | Veteran Trooper. Any and all ranks below will not receive the veteran role when retiring.

You will not be eligible for retirement if: you have been warned less than 24 hours ago, striked less than 48 hours ago, or demoted less than a week ago.

If you are demoted you will no longer be eligible for any former role. (Only applies to reinstated troopers.)

@FHP Ghost | Low Rank

Upon reinstatement, you will no longer be eligible for @FHP Ghost | Veteran Trooper. You will need to rank up to High Rank in order to gain eligibility.

@FHP Ghost | High Rank

Upon reinstatement, you will no longer be eligible for @FHP Ghost | Former HR; you will be required to rank up to Senior High Rank to gain eligibility.

@FHP Ghost | Senior High Rank

Any Senior High Rank who reinstates, is required to be an employee for a minimum of 2 months to gain eligibility for @FHP Ghost | Former SHR.

@FHP Ghost | High Command

Any High Command who reinstates, is required to be an employee for a minimum of 2.5 months to gain eligibility for @FHP Ghost | Former HICOM.

If any brackets are full-for example, Senior High Rank is full-you will be placed into a bracket below it. You will still have the possibility to gain your prior former role if you follow its requirement. So in this case, you would need to be HR for 2 months minimum.

title: 1.13 Infraction Charter
html:
Base Rules

  • Accumulating 3 warnings will result in the issuance of Strike 1.
  • Accumulating 2 further warnings following Strike 1 will result in the issuance of Strike 2.
  • Accumulating 2 strikes and 1 warning will result in termination.
  • Probationary Troopers who accumulate 1 strike and 1 warning will be subject to immediate termination.
  • High Rank personnel must obtain approval from Senior High Rank or above prior to issuing an infraction.
  • All personnel must obtain approval from High Command prior to issuing a suspension or termination.

Verbal Warnings

  • Failure to maintain proper spelling, punctuation, and grammar (SPaG) while on-duty.
  • Failure to use the correct introduction when identifying.
  • Failure to adhere to the Chain of Command.
  • Disrespectful conduct toward other members. (Severity dependent.)
  • Use of an incorrect call-sign.
  • Use of an incorrect uniform while on-duty. (Includes default uniform, uniforms designated for higher ranks, or absence of uniform.)
  • Use of Ghost Unit uniforms on other teams or while off-duty.
  • Shift grinding. (First offense) [+void of ongoing shift]
  • Shift grinding. (Second offense) [+void of ongoing shift & exclusion from promotions]
  • Using vessel without proper certification.
  • Using canine without proper certification.

Warnings

  • Failure to comply with vehicle guidelines following a prior verbal warning.
  • Failure to comply with weapon guidelines following a prior verbal warning.
  • Failure to maintain proper SPaG while on-duty following a prior verbal warning.
  • Use of an incorrect call-sign following a prior verbal warning.
  • Failure to roleplay a crash.
  • Use of an incorrect uniform while on-duty following a prior verbal warning.
  • Use of Ghost Unit uniforms on other teams or while off-duty following a prior verbal warning.
  • Violation of traffic laws while on-duty.
  • Misconduct while on-duty.
  • Initiating a traffic stop without probable cause.
  • Conducting traffic stops on whitelisted departments for traffic violations.
  • Shift grinding. (Third offense and onward) [+void of ongoing shift & exclusion from promotions]
  • Using vessel without proper certification.
  • Using canine without proper certification.

Strikes

  • Roleplaying as a Ghost Unit member while holding a trainee rank.
  • Mass misconduct or repeated violation of in-game rules. (Severity dependent.)
  • Violation of Discord community rules. (Severity dependent.)
  • Failure to roleplay a crash following a prior warning.
  • Violation of in-game rules. (Including but not limited to: RDM, VDM, NLR.)

Suspensions

  • Multiple or repeated violations of Ghost Unit regulations.
  • Being the subject of multiple substantiated reports submitted via tickets.
  • Abuse of rank or authority.
  • Violation of the Roblox Terms of Service. (Severity dependent.)
  • Violation of the Discord Terms of Service. (Severity dependent.)
  • Inciting or perpetuating drama within Ghost Unit or with external departments. (Severity dependent.)

Terminations

  • Leaking rank-restricted channels, documents, or embeds.
  • Failure to meet community standards.
  • Failing two training sessions.
  • Persistent inactivity without an approved Leave of Absence. (Progressive: Warning → Strike → Termination.)
  • Compromise of a Discord or Roblox account.
  • Determined to be unfit for Ghost Unit membership.
  • Accumulation of 2 strikes and 1 warning.
  • Accumulation of 1 strike and 1 warning as a Probationary Trooper.
